x: Julie did an excellent job as narrator with Tina co-ordinating the guests and by the sound of the delighted exclamations greeting each arrival it was clear that the idea was an enormous success.
Another great find was Julie Bernard who, at the last minute, was persuaded to run the final leg of the 4 x 400m relay. Julie is quite new to Belgrave and had so far only competed up to 200 metres.
A brave heptathlon from Julie Julie Hollman had a brave heptathlon, placing 6th and throwing a best ever javelin after overcoming the near-disaster of two “no jumps” in the long jump.
By such small margins victories are won and lost. Thanks once again to Julie and Tony Ganio for keeping the semi injured useable.
